title: Boku no Hero Academia the Movie 4: You're Next
content:
Possibly the best MhA movie? No, definitely. There will be some minor or mild spoilers below but nothing to hurt the enjoyment of a first watch.

I have always viewed My Hero Academia movies like an afterthought. Maybe because I was still old gen trio pilled, but MhA proved its worth through seasons of dedication and quality that it’s hard to deny it its fair share of praise. Non of its movies have been anywhere close to being memorable for me, except for this.

I can easily rely it to the stellar animation extravaganza that it was, but no, not only that, it was simply the “what-if” plot it risked itself for.

What if All-Might was a villain, that way we could get him vs. everybody else. A thought so showered in absurdity it’s hard to entertain. By some narrative twists and turn, it turned out to be possible while still remaining within the terms of reason. Enter, Dark Might.

Truly a movie fit to sort of wave goodbye to the franchise as a whole, having invited all class A and heroes to participate, although not doing too much and leaving most of the spotlight to Deku, Bakugo and Shoto, to no one4s surprise.

The movie itself had nothing else to boast about other than the idea behind the villain, which to be honest does scratch some of the itch with the whole All-Might gone bad premise.

Overall: 8.42/10.
